result.description:
Duties 

Financial Reporting 

- Prepare and review month-end/quarter-end journals under all relevant accounting bases, ensuring process integrity and continuous improvement. 

- Prepare and oversee monthly Balance Sheet reconciliations, ensuring the general ledger is accurately maintained and all interfacing systems are correctly posted. 

- Consolidate financial results and report accurately to Group Finance. 

Support the preparation of accurate and comprehensive annual statutory financial statements, as well as regulatory and tax returns, in alignment with the December year-end reporting cycle. 

- Monitor developments in accounting standards and regulatory requirements, assess their impact on financial reporting and implement necessary changes. 

- Oversee tax-related filings in collaboration with tax advisors. 

- Provide technical support and advice on accounting treatments. 

- Maintain efficient, systematic filing and documentation processes. 

- Drive process optimization and technology adoption for greater efficiency. 

Audit & Compliance 

- Plan and coordinate audit processes to ensure timely regulatory reporting. 

- Liaise with internal and external auditors, ensuring compliance with accounting and financial regulations. 

- Maintain and implement internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure accurate reporting. 

Business Support & projects 

- Contribute to Back Office transformation project, Project Unify, supporting process improvement and system integration efforts

- Manage and participate in ad-hoc projects and cross-functional initiatives.

- Collaborate with other departments to align financial processes with business objectives.

- Mentor and guide junior accounting staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Experience

- Professional accounting designation (CPA/ACCA or equivalent).

- Minimum of 3 years’ post-qualification experience in accounting, financial reporting and analysis.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving and technical accounting skills.

- Excellent time management skills, with the flexibility and efficiency to collaborate across multiple time zones and global teams.

- Proactive, adaptable individual with strong leadership, and process evaluation abilities, with a holistic view to technology integration and automation

- Strong proficiency in general ledger systems, BI tools, and enterprise finance applications (e.g., SAP AFO, PeopleSoft, Oracle).

- Deep understanding of various accounting frameworks, including IFRS and US GAAP. Experience working in multi-jurisdictional environments is a plus.

- Experience & good understanding of reinsurance/insurance accounting and knowledge of actuarial concepts is ideal, but not necessary.

- Strong interpersonal/negotiation skills with the ability to build relationships with different functional areas and work effectively within a team environment.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment.

Background 

The Senior Financial Accountant, Financial Reporting role sits within our Pacific Life Re (PL Re) Financial Reporting and Tax team, reporting directly to the Manager, Financial Reporting. The role will be based in Australia and will include hybrid working arrangement (up to 4 days a week in office). 
 
The role supports the Financial Reporting team in delivering external reporting requirements across multiple bases of reporting including US GAAP, IFRS, regulatory reporting across various jurisdictions and internal Economic Capital Base.
 
The role is responsible for the preparation, analysis and delivery of financial reports on multiple accounting frameworks (e.g. US GAAP, IFRS and multiple local regulatory/internal bases as required). The role involves close collaboration with Financial Reporting and Tax, Financial Management and Treasury, Actuarial, Operations and other teams within PL Re and its parent company, Pacific Life (PL). 
 
The role is pivotal in month-end and quarter-end processes, annual statutory financial statement preparation, and ensuring compliance with statutory, regulatory, and technical accounting standards in the insurance industry. The position also encompasses tax compliance, accounting analysis, and audit support.
 
This role serves as a key contributor to the financial and regulatory reporting and supporting finance-related project activities as required.

result.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Toolmaker – Moulding to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, refurbishment, modification, and manufacture of moulding tools and equipment used in production. This role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and a commitment to quality and safety.

Monday - Friday, 6:00am - 2:30pm
$40 - $45 per hour

Key Responsibilities
Manufacture, assemble, and fit precision mould tools, components, and fixtures.
Perform maintenance, repair, and modification of existing moulds to ensure optimal performance.
Read and interpret technical drawings, CAD files, and engineering specifications.
Collaborate with engineering, production and maintenance teams to troubleshoot tooling and moulding issues.
Conduct testing and commissioning of new mould tools.
Ensure moulds meet required tolerances and quality standards.
Operate toolroom machinery such as manual and CNC machines including lathes, milling machines, grinders, EDM and drilling equipment.
Perform preventative maintenance and ensure tooling is production ready.
Identify process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintain accurate records of tool modifications, repairs, and maintenance schedules.
Follow workplace health and safety regulations at all times.

Qualifications, Experience and Skills
Trade qualification in Toolmaking, Fitter & Turner, or equivalent.
Proven experience in mould manufacture, maintenance, refurbishment, and repair making, preferably
           in injection moulding, blow moulding, die-casting, or similar manufacturing processes.
Strong knowledge of machining processes (CNC, milling, turning, grinding, EDM).
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
High attention to detail and precision.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience with CAD/CAM software (desirable).
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
General Construction Induction Certificate (Blue/White Card)
Current Working at Heights and Confined Space tickets
Current valid Driver’s license

result.description:
ACR Tech are your trusted partner in cutting-edge technology solutions for coating removal, and the home of RPR Induction Coating Removal - the future of efficient and eco-friendly surface preparation. With a relentless commitment to innovation, ACR Tech is dedicated to revolutionizing the way industries approach coating removal challenges. Our RPR Induction Coating Removal system is designed to deliver unprecedented precision, speed, and sustainability in removing coatings from a wide range of surfaces.

ACR highly skilled Heat Treatment technicians have in-depth knowledge of materials, processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effect of coating removal

We are seeking highly experienced MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN to join our team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis. We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Maintaining and repairing of various equipment and machineries
Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Attend to mechanical issues and troubleshoot machine/equipment breakdowns
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment.
Undertake on-going preventative maintenance inspections of machinery and equipment, to identify and repair or report critical issues.
Performs major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors.
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance.
Maintaining non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment.
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials.
Perform routine maintenance on equipment and machines
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line.
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations.
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation.
Supports improvement projects.
Fabricates and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment.
Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance.
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures.
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed.
Communicating with and supporting engineers
Understand customer change request and provide schedule
Documenting machine safety and maintenance

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you have the skills & experience we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
